stapler.title: Stapler
stapler.prompt: A chunky red office stapler, closed, toy-like rounded shapes, simple clean colours, single object
stapler.motion: Keep the base fixed on the table. Add a hinge at the back so the top arm swings open about 40 degrees and then snaps shut quickly, repeating.

fan.title: Desk fan
fan.prompt: A small retro desk fan with a round wire cage, light blue body and white blades, cartoon toy style, single object
fan.motion: Keep the base and the stand fixed. The fan blades and their hub rotate continuously around the central axle.

jack.title: Jack-in-the-box
jack.prompt: A colourful toy jack-in-the-box: a square tin box with a crank handle on the side and a closed hinged lid on top, cartoon style, single object
jack.motion: Keep the box fixed. The lid on top is hinged at the back edge and flips open about 110 degrees, then closes. The crank handle on the side rotates around its axle.
